label: WordPress Developer
register: The buyer is a small trades business owner evaluating whether this solo developer looks credible and trustworthy enough to hand over their website and lead-generation, judged against other freelance web developers and small agencies rather than large enterprise dev shops.

sites.name: Brittany Chiang
sites.why: Fixed-sidebar hero with a single strong intro line and one clear CTA (email) shows confident, minimal typographic hierarchy that reads as instantly credible.

sites.name: Jack Jeznach
sites.why: Oversized hero statement plus a one-line value prop and subtle scroll animation proves a solo freelancer's homepage can look agency-polished without heavy production.

sites.name: Adham Dannaway
sites.why: Leads the hero with outcome-focused case studies and recognizable client logos instead of a headshot, building trust for a one-person operation fast.

sites.name: Codeable
sites.why: Hero built entirely around vetting/trust language, ratings, and client logos — the exact pattern needed to reassure a skeptical small-business buyer about handing over their site.

sites.name: TMN Creative
sites.why: Speaks directly to 'owner-operators' with flat pricing and turnaround time stated above the fold, matching the small-trades-buyer register almost exactly.

sites.name: Oak Harbor Web Designs
sites.why: Plain-English $0-down / $175-a-month pricing and a hand-coded-by-a-real-person promise in the hero is a direct comparable for a solo dev selling to local small-business owners.
